definitions.short: to strip off, i.e. generally to make naked (for exertion or in disgrace), to drain away or bail up (a liquid)
definitions.usage: make bare, clean, discover, draw out, take, uncover.
definitions.full: H2834. chasaph חָשַׂף verb strip off, strip, make bare — Qal Perfect חָשַׂף Isa 52:10 , חֲשָׂפָהּ Joel 1:7 , חָשַׂפְתִּי Jer 13:26 ; 49:10 ; Imperfect וַיֶּחֱשׂף Psa 29:9 ; Imperative feminine singular חֶשְׂמִּיֿ Isa 47:2 ; Infinitive absolute חָשׂף Joel 1:7 ; construct לַחְשׂף Isa 30:14 ; Hag 2:16 ; Passive participle חֲשׂוּפָה Ezek 4:7 , חֲשׂוּפַי Isa 20:4 (plural construct ? compare below ). — 1 strip off , expose oneself by removing (object שֹׁבֶל , flowing skirt, train) Isa 47:2 of Babylon, personified as queen (|| שׁוֺק גַּלִּי ), ׳ח עַלמָּֿנַיִךְ שׁוּלַיִךְ Jer 13:26 . 2 strip, lay bare , figurative of ׳י Isa 52:10 object קדשׁו זְרוֺעַ ; of prophet, Ezek 4:7 (but Co strike out see as interpolation); object person Jer 49:10 (|| גִּלֵּיתִי ); חשׂפהּ חָשׂף Joel 1:7 of locusts stripping fig-tree; שֵׁת חֲשׂוּפַי Isa 20:4 (participle either singular collective, with formative ending יַ֯ , De Lag Se i. 19 (compare 69), BN 192; or plural construct, see Ges § 87 , 1 c.); ׳ח יְעָרוֺת Psa 29:9 of voice of ׳י (i.e. a storm) stripping forests. 3 draw (water) Isa 30:14 ; (wine) Hag 2:16 ; properly take from the surface, skim . חֲשׂוּפַי Isa 20:4 see חשׂף . above

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve,
so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

He will break it as a potter’s vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there won’t be found among the broken pieces a piece good enough to take fire from the hearth, or to dip up water out of the cistern.”
Take the millstones and grind flour.
Yahweh has made his holy arm bare in the eyes of all the nations.
Therefore I will also uncover your skirts on your face,
But I have made Esau bare,
You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.
He has laid my vine waste,
He has laid my vine waste,
Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty.
